dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL free-format source, part of the Applewood Computers Accounting System (ACAS v3.02+), authored by Vincent Bryan Coen. Uses >>source free directive and *> comments characteristic of GnuCOBOL.

purpose.domain_detail: Applewood Computers Accounting System (ACAS) - delivery file restore utility that reads a sequential backup file and restores records to an ISAM delivery file
purpose.summary: This program restores a delivery file from a sequential (.seq) backup file. It opens the sequential file for input and the ISAM delivery file for output, reads all records from the sequential file and writes them to the ISAM file, then reports counts of records processed. It is the restore counterpart to a corresponding unload/backup program.

notable_features: COPY statements for modular file definitions (envdiv.cob, seldel.cob, fddel.cob, wsdel.cob, wscall.cob, wsnames.cob, wsfnctn.cob, Test-Data-Flags.cob, Proc-Get-Env-Set-Files.cob)
CALL to external ACAS-Sysout logging module
High comment ratio (~52%) with extensive copyright and change-log comments
GOBACK used instead of STOP RUN
verdict.notes: High comment ratio (52%) is due to extensive copyright notice and change-log comments embedded in the source. The program is clearly part of a larger production accounting system (ACAS) with modular copybooks and a shared logging subsystem. Nine COPY statements reference external copybooks not shown here. The program appears complete and functional.
